title: Washington Trust names Holly Knott senior vice president, director of…
summary: The Washington Trust Company (Washington Trust) has announced that Holly M. Knott has been named senior vice president, director of client acquisition and…
body_markdown:
**WESTERLY, R.I.** – The Washington Trust Company ([Washington Trust](https://www.washtrust.com/) ) today announced that[Holly M. Knott](https://www.washtrustwealth.com/team/holly-knott) **** has been named **senior vice president, director of client acquisition and experience** for Washington Trust Wealth Management (Wealth Management). In her new role, Knott will lead client acquisition and client experience strategy, working with colleagues across Wealth Management, Retail Lending and Commercial Banking to address clients’ broader financial needs and connect them with the appropriate expertise throughout Washington Trust.


Knott began her career at Washington Trust in 2001 as a teller at the Bank’s Narragansett branch. Within a year, she moved into a new role on the Retail Banking team as a merchant sales representative, assisting businesses with credit card and payment processing solutions. In 2005, Knott joined the Retail Lending team as a mortgage loan officer, working with clients on traditional and reverse mortgages.


Knott became an assistant vice president, wealth planning officer in 2014, advising individuals and institutional clients on complex wealth planning, trust and estate planning needs. In 2016, she completed the Certified Financial Planning program at Bryant University, became a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® professional, and was later promoted to vice president, senior wealth planning officer in Wealth Management.


“Throughout her career, Holly has demonstrated a drive to learn and grow as well as an unwavering commitment to exceptional client service,” **said Washington Trust Chairman and CEO Ned Handy** . “Her ability to build meaningful relationships with clients, colleagues, outside professionals and business partners, together with her extensive knowledge of Washington Trust, has been central to her success and will serve her well in this expanded leadership role.”


Knott is a member of the Rhode Island Estate and Tax Planning Council, serves on the Board of Directors of the VNA of Care New England Foundation, and volunteers with Meals on Wheels RI. She is also a recipient of the President’s Volunteer Service Award from the Corporation for National and Community Service.


Knott holds a bachelor’s degree from the University of Rhode Island.


**ABOUT WASHINGTON TRUST WEALTH MANAGEMENT** ®


Washington Trust Wealth Management ("WTWM") is a premier regional wealth advisory group with more than $7.9 billion in assets under administration, as of September 30, 2026. WTWM provides client-focused financial solutions to individuals, families, foundations, endowments, municipalities, and businesses. WTWM delivers customized financial planning, broad investment management, and full trust services to clients from its offices in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Connecticut. Washington Trust Wealth Management is a registered trademark of[The Washington Trust Company](https://www.washtrust.com/) , which has licensed its use to its parent, affiliates, and subsidiaries, including Washington Trust Advisors, Inc., an SEC-registered investment adviser. Additional information can be found at[www.washtrustwealth.com](http://www.washtrustwealth.com/) .
